auto_sync.new_table_policy: A table discovered in production but absent from this manifest is added with teardown_class='unclassified' and status='manual_implementation_required'. The gate then FAILS until a human states the ownership and deletion rules. Generated schema metadata is never allowed to author a deletion rule.

critical_options.cpsd_baseline_pending: Sealed pre-provisioning baseline; the only recovery evidence for an interrupted run.
critical_options.cpsd_manifest: Sealed ownership manifest; without it teardown cannot prove what it owns.

features.title: Consultation-fee defaults, per-visit overrides and itemized charges
Booking/visit/invoice demo across every demo persona (pre-0030 surface)

safety_invariants.why: Defect D: save()/write_tombstone()/save_pending_baseline() ignored the return value of update_option(), and teardown cleared the sealed pending baseline before the tombstone was durably stored. A failed write left synthetic rows with no recoverable ownership state.
Defect D: the pending baseline must survive until the replacement manifest is durably stored AND read back verified.
Defect E: only the two justified heartbeat options may be normalised. A blanket exemption for shared options would hide unauthorised changes to preexisting records.
Defect F: a synthetic WordPress user must not be deleted while a foreign-owned patient-user link or OTP record still depends on it.
Defect G: the append-only audit hash chain is verified end to end and never deleted; only the three inert parent anchors are retained.

The scoped teardown OR-connected every resolvable ownership column, so a post-baseline row of a FOREIGN Clinic that merely named a synthetic demo WordPress user was claimed as demo-owned. Its id entered the clinician/membership id-sets and the next collection pass used those ids to claim foreign visits, clinical records, invoices and payments, which were then deleted. Ownership is now one mandatory rule per table - the demo tenant boundary, or the declared parent of a tenant-less table - and a WordPress user id is only ever a dependency signal.
Defect B: tables without an `id` column were skipped entirely, so their fixture rows were neither collected, deleted, nor detected as remaining.
Defect A: one shared membership_ids set let a clinic-membership id delete foreign organization-membership capability rows on auto-increment overlap.

schema_pin_scan.why: Both companion lanes assert the production schema head in a shell test. When production advanced to 2026_10_27_0030 those assertions went stale, and because the lanes' path filters exclude clinic-practice-management/** they failed only on the next companion PR. Scanning them here turns that latent breakage into an evaluated fact.

cpms_audit_logs.rationale: Append-only audit hash chain; teardown verifies it, never deletes it.

cpms_clinics.rationale: Audit-log FK target: archived in place as an inert anchor.

cpms_jobs.rationale: Shared queue; only fixture-owned job ids from the closed allowlist are deleted.

cpms_license_install.rationale: Install-level licence identity, not tenant data.

cpms_license_state.rationale: Install-level licence runtime state, not tenant data.

cpms_locations.rationale: Audit-log FK target: deactivated in place as an inert anchor.

cpms_operational_logs.rationale: Shared log; only rows whose context matches the fixture are deleted.

cpms_organizations.rationale: Audit-log FK target: archived in place as an inert anchor.

cpms_rate_limits.rationale: Shared keyed counters; only fixture-derived window keys are deleted.

cpms_schema_migrations.rationale: Migration bookkeeping written by MigrationRunner; always preserved.

volatile_options.cpms_backup_last_run_at: Backup heartbeat rewritten by each scheduled backup run.
volatile_options.cpms_jobs_last_tick_at: Queue heartbeat rewritten by every successful queue tick (autoload=no).
